scenarios.prompt: Map an input-design semantic action set onto a keyboard/mouse preset with a declared pointer role and context-specific conflicts, then rebind one action without changing gameplay identity.

criteria.ownership: input-design owns semantic actions and conflicts; this skill owns preset defaults only.
criteria.identity: Input preset/revision, device capability, action and physical binding are explicit.
criteria.evidence: Rebinding changes controls without changing gameplay action identity or timing.
